summary: Tested 3 P1 features (auto-adapt recommendation, streak/daily-goal, per-keystroke trace). Backend pytest expanded from 22 -> 32 tests (added 10 new tests across streak, recommendation, keystrokes), 32/32 passing. Caught and fixed a real REGRESSION introduced by keystrokes feature: GET /api/sessions returned 500 because list endpoint projected out keystrokes then passed None to SessionOut whose field expects a List. Frontend e2e via Playwright confirmed: dashboard renders streak-card / daily-goal-card / recommendation-card with correct empty-state values, apply-recommendation-btn fires 'auto-adapt applied.' toast and updates difficulty/length pills, full Practice -> Results flow runs end-to-end and Results renders typing-trace chart driven by real per-keystroke data.

minor.issue: FIXED IN THIS ITERATION. Was returning 500 - root cause: projection {_id:0, keystrokes:0} drops keystrokes field, then `SessionOut(**{k: it.get(k) ...})` passed keystrokes=None which violates Pydantic field type List[Dict]. Patched in /app/backend/sessions_router.py to filter out None kwargs so default_factory takes effect.

ui_bugs.issue: Carryover from iter 1 - ResponsiveContainer warns 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on first paint. Chart still renders correctly after layout settles. Suggest fixed minHeight or aspect ratio on the wrapper.

action_items: (Optional) Validate the list_sessions fix in /app/backend/sessions_router.py - kwargs are now filtered to drop None so SessionOut default_factory keystrokes=[] applies. Regression test now covers it (TestSessions::test_list_sessions + TestKeystrokes::test_list_endpoint_excludes_keystrokes).
(Carryover from iter 1) Recharts ResponsiveContainer width=-1/height=-1 warnings on Results page - give chart wrapper an explicit height (h-64) or aspect ratio.
(Carryover from iter 1) TypingArena 'Maximum update depth exceeded' warning from onLiveStats effect - wrap onLiveStats in useCallback in Practice.jsx.
critical_code_review_comments: REGRESSION found: list_sessions used a destructive projection (keystrokes:0) but SessionOut Pydantic model declares keystrokes as List[Dict] - passing None caused 500. Fix applied. Same risk pattern exists for any future field added to SessionOut that gets projected away; consider switching to model construction via model_validate(it) with extra='ignore' to be more robust.

_compute_streak: uses datetime.fromisoformat(i['created_at']).date() which only counts UTC day boundaries - users in non-UTC timezones may see streak/today drift up to ~12h. Acceptable for v1, document or use user-locale eventually.
_compute_recommendation: only bumps from Beginner->Intermediate->Advanced; once at Advanced it stays. Correct given DIFFICULTY_ORDER bounds. The reason strings are good UX.
Keystrokes payload capped at 2000 per session client-side (TypingArena slice) - prevents bloat. Backend has no explicit cap; consider validating len(keystrokes) <= e.g. 5000 server-side to harden.
stats/overview correctly excludes keystrokes from the projection for performance - good. Stats already fetches up to 2000 sessions; without that exclusion this would be a memory/perf risk.

Frontend Dashboard: apply-recommendation-btn correctly mutates local difficulty + length state and shows toast; scroll-to-begin uses querySelector inside an arrow callback - works but consider useRef for resilience.

context_for_next_testing_agent: P1 backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_streak_recommendation_keystrokes.py cover (a) empty user defaults (streak=0, rec=Beginner/short), (b) today-count + current-streak after first session, (c) goal_met after 3 daily sessions, (d) bump to Advanced when avg acc>=95 & wpm>=50, (e) drop to Beginner when avg acc<85, (f) stay-in-lane medium length when 88<=acc<95, (g) keystrokes round-trip on GET /sessions/{id}, (h) keystrokes EXCLUDED from GET /sessions list, (i) backwards-compat for sessions without keystrokes. The list_sessions 500 regression was fixed in sessions_router.py - if main agent reverts to a destructive projection pattern in future, prefer letting Pydantic default_factory fill missing fields by filtering None kwargs (or use model_validate with extra='ignore').
rca of the issue: GET /api/sessions 500: sessions_router.list_sessions did `db.sessions.find(query, {'_id':0, 'keystrokes':0})` to keep list payloads small, then constructed `SessionOut(**{k: it.get(k) for k in SessionOut.model_fields.keys()})`. Because keystrokes were projected out, it.get('keystrokes') returned None, but SessionOut.keystrokes is typed `List[Dict[str, Any]]` (default_factory=list) and Pydantic v2 rejects None for non-Optional list -> ValidationError -> FastAPI 500. Mitigation: build kwargs with `{k: v for k,v in (...) if v is not None}` so default_factory applies. Verified by re-running pytest and adding a regression test (test_list_endpoint_excludes_keystrokes) that confirms list responds 200 and keystrokes default to [].
